verdict.rationale: Unity's in-editor AI Assistant (com.unity.ai.assistant, beta) is documented to 'analyze performance' and take project actions from natural-language prompts. Assistant messages are metered via Unity Credits. This is a first-party, in-product way to get AI analysis of project data, but the evidence is a single thin line, and proactive insights or suggestions are not described. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced from user/project data, detail on what data the Assistant analyzes, non-beta status, independent or hands-on corroboration.
